title: List Display popover: with three export formats the footer overflows and "Export as JSON" is clipped outside the popover
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXSZs9PBUc2H8z6mtB

Filing gate: ① user-visible UX defect, stable on screen, landing named, expectation not a matter of taste (reach: console list Display popover at 1440x900, measured by bounding boxes and a screenshot).
Business reason: a view that offers CSV, XLSX and JSON export shows the user only two of them. The third button is cut to "Exp" past the popover's edge, and on narrower windows it is off screen. A user who needs JSON (an integrator, an admin moving data) cannot see that it is offered. The export clauses of records-forms.list-view-capabilities pass only because automation clicks the hidden button.
Reader who acts: the ui lane (`ui/packages/plugin-list`): let the export group wrap, or move it to its own row in the popover footer.
Dedupe: `"Export as JSON"` 31 hits (closed export cards #24183, #19020, #27682, #16045, #15630, none about this layout); `ViewSettingsPopover export overflow` 1 (#27545, closed, record drawer v4, unrelated).

QA-source: #29172 · records-forms.list-view-capabilities · observed beside the clauses

## What happens

Tasks › In Progress declares `exportOptions` csv, xlsx and json. Measured with an admin who holds an export grant, at 1440x900, after opening the Display popover (`toolbar-display-trigger`):
- The popover spans x 1073..1393.
- "Export as CSV" spans 1114..1240 and "Export as XLSX" spans 1244..1376.
- "Export as JSON" spans 1380..1514, past the popover's right edge.
- The footer's scrollWidth is 440 against a clientWidth of 318. The screenshot shows the third entry cut to "Exp".

Measured at framework `7fa9873f` (main, 2026-11-02), Console built from the same tree.

## Reproduction

1. Showcase boot, signed in as admin with an export grant.
2. Open `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task/view/in_progress` and click the Display button.
3. **Expected:** all three export buttons are visible and reachable inside the popover.
4. **Actual:** "Export as JSON" overflows the popover and is clipped.

## Mechanism (read at 7fa9873f)

`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/components/ViewSettingsPopover.tsx` around L681. The footer is `flex-wrap`, but the refresh button and the export buttons sit together in one inner `ml-auto flex items-center gap-1` div that does not wrap. Its intrinsic width (refresh plus three "Export as X" buttons) is wider than the fixed-width popover, so it spills out with overflow visible.
